coursesReviewed.name: Consumer Product Design

Students investigate product mechanisms and environmental impact, interview potential customers, translate needs into specifications, select concepts, and develop production plans and prototypes where feasible. The final project integrates these stages with industrial scaling and elementary economic analysis. Sustainability, including material use, repairability, lifespan and circularity, informs design decisions throughout.
coursesReviewed.contributionFinding: Product design/needs/prototypes are substantive methods; no supported child/education brief.

coursesReviewed.name: Psychology of Leading Under Pressure

Students conduct a supervised quantitative survey project: formulating theory-driven hypotheses, selecting established psychological measures, designing and piloting a Qualtrics survey, recruiting participants ethically, collecting original data and preparing a clean dataset. Individual work applies descriptive statistics, reliability analysis, correlations, group comparisons and introductory multiple regression in SPSS or RStudio, and interprets findings and limitations in empirical reports and evidence-based leadership recommendations.
coursesReviewed.contributionFinding: Inclusive/emotion-regulation leadership and actual surveys; not childdevelopment or schoolintervention by assumption.
